name: Universal Remove Tooltips
description: Removes tooltip popups that clutter the TV screen and are hard to dismiss with remote

params.css: [role='tooltip'], .tooltip, [class*='tooltip'], [class*='Tooltip'], [data-tooltip], [data-tippy], .tippy-box, .tippy-content, [class*='popover']:not([class*='modal']), [class*='Popover']:not([class*='Modal']) { display: none !important; visibility: hidden !important; opacity: 0 !important; pointer-events: none !important; } [title] { position: relative !important; } [title]:hover::after, [title]:hover::before { display: none !important; }
